Confirm whether the 2025-02-01 lease changed the base rent. If it did, that increase must itself have been licensed (Housing Inventory reporting in effect for 1-9 unit buildings since 2023-03-01), properly noticed (30/90-day rule), and within the cap then in effect (1.7% for increases effective 2024-03-01–2025-02-28, plus banked increases).

A one-time 12.1% increase after ~7.5 years of no increases is lawful (banked increases have no stated cap on the total; notice must identify the banked portions — see official worked example in S1) but is more likely to draw tenant scrutiny. Consider phasing (e.g., impose only the 1.6% now) — a business judgment, not a legal requirement.
